target.title: fix(ai): cache and case-insensitively match Azure deployment map
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`resolveAzureDeploymentNameFromMap` (in `packages/ai`) maps a model id to an Azure
deployment name on hot paths — it runs while building Azure Responses params for
every stream and lifecycle hook (`src/agents/openai-transport-stream.ts`,
`packages/ai/src/providers/azure-openai-responses.ts`). It had two problems:

1. **404s from case mismatches.** The lookup was case-sensitive. If
   `AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT_NAME_MAP` maps `gpt-4o=deployment-gpt-4o` but the model
   id arrives as `GPT-4o`, the lookup missed and fell back to the **raw model id**;
   Azure then returned `404` "deployment not found".
2. **Re-parsing on every call.** It rebuilt a `Map` from the deployment-map string
   on every resolution, allocating and GC-ing on a hot path.

## Root Cause

```ts
return parseAzureDeploymentNameMap(params.deploymentMap).get(params.modelId) || params.modelId;
```

Parses the string every call, and `get(params.modelId)` is exact-case.

## What Changed

- Cache the parsed lookup map keyed by the raw deployment-map string, bounded to 32
  entries so memory stays flat even if a caller ever varies the input (the map comes
  from a stable env var in practice).
- Normalize keys to lowercase and look up with `modelId.toLowerCase()`, so matching
  is case-insensitive.
- Deployment names (the values) stay **verbatim** because Azure requires the exact
  deployment name; the fallback still returns the original-cased model id.

Both call sites are unchanged.

## Evidence

Focused tests — `packages/ai/src/providers/azure-deployment-map.test.ts`, 6 passed:

```
 ✓ preserves equals signs inside deployment names
 ✓ falls back to the model id when the map has no usable entry
 ✓ matches model ids case-insensitively when the request casing differs
 ✓ preserves the deployment name casing verbatim
 ✓ preserves the original model id casing on fallback
 ✓ caches the parsed lookup map per deployment-map string
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  6 passed (6)
```

Standalone before/after harness (imports the real source and the pre-fix logic):

```
=== Issue #102936: case-insensitive lookup (the 404 bug) ===
deploymentMap = "gpt-4o=deployment-gpt-4o", request modelId = "GPT-4o"
  OLD -> "GPT-4o"            (raw model id -> Azure 404: deployment not found)
  NEW -> "deployment-gpt-4o" (correct deployment)

=== Performance: 500,000 resolutions of the same map string ===
  OLD (re-parses every call): 103.2 ms
  NEW (cached parse):         17.7 ms
  speedup: 5.8x fewer allocations on the hot path

ALL CHECKS PASSED
```

AI-assisted.

Fixes #102936
